name: Kinloom Family
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a shared family calendar, family organizer, chores or grocery list app. Pale sky boards with chunky Fredoka headlines, paper-cut blobs and die-cut stickers. One big tilted phone with a colorful week view runs across the first two screenshots, with event cards pinned over it; then a tilted grid of twelve tool cards, a grocery list with ticked items popping out of the phone, and a chores screen with stars and a pizza night reward. Cards, pills and phones are named layer groups, and every blob and sticker is its own layer.
